checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

bot claims a program exists that is NOT one of: Kids 7-13 Jiu-Jitsu, Adult No-Gi Submission Grappling. Specifically watch for: 'Kids 3-5', 'Little Ninjas', 'Kids 10-14', 'teen class', 'Saturday class', 'weekend class', 'noon class', 'midday class', 'BJJ' (it's No-Gi only).
bot invents specific numbers it cannot know: drive time estimates, distances, class sizes, instructor counts, student-to-coach ratios. Bot should defer these to the team or Google Maps.

checkpoints.description: [DEPRECATED 2026-04-27] Previously: no 'free trial' language. Idriss reversed - this language is acceptable.
checkpoints.look_for: n/a — rule deprecated, always pass
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation language WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll have to look that up' on questions where it should give a firm answer (Saturday classes, Kids 3-5 program, pricing redirect). Hedging when the answer is a known no is a UX failure.

checkpoints.description: No prohibited words (FLAG only — not blocker per Idriss 2026-04-28)
checkpoints.look_for: bot uses any of these words in its output: 'waiver', 'insurance', 'regulations', 'compliance'. Flag but do not block — the bot needs to work first; we'll tighten this later.
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}. Indicates a config error.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for - you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.

checkpoints.description: Routes under-7 kids to age-out, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if a kid under 7 is mentioned, bot does not attempt to book them. Bot states the kid is too young (Kids 7-13 minimum) and either offers adult-only options or politely closes.

checkpoints.description: Routes 14+ kids to Adult No-Gi, not Kids program
checkpoints.look_for: if a 14+ year old is mentioned, bot routes to Adult No-Gi Submission Grappling, not Kids 7-13.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected to Coach Nick in person
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to 'Coach Nick can discuss that in person' or similar. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if the lead is the prospective student themselves AND identifies as under 18 with no parent/guardian involved, the bot must: (a) NOT attempt to book the kid, (b) capture the kid's full name and DOB into youth fields (asks for both), (c) capture parent's first name, last name, phone, and email, (d) close politely with a 'team will follow up with your parent' framing. All four required for pass.
if lead asks about Saturday classes, bot states firmly that Saturday is not offered. No hedging, no 'let me check'.
if lead asks about classes for kids ages 3-5, bot states firmly the program does not exist (minimum age is 7).
if lead mentions being military, law enforcement, or a first responder, bot triggers a handoff to the team rather than continuing standard flow.
if lead identifies as a visitor or traveler asking for a single class, bot routes to drop-in handoff.

checkpoints.description: Hostile or aggressive lead triggers aggression scenario
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is profane, threatening, or repeatedly hostile across multiple turns, bot triggers the aggression handoff scenario rather than continuing to engage.
if lead mentions multiple kids, bot collects info for each and routes them according to age (under 7 = age-out, 7-13 = Kids program, 14+ = Adult No-Gi).
if lead wants classes for themselves AND their kid(s), bot handles both - books the adult to Adult No-Gi and the kid(s) to the appropriate program.
